answer: An audited work portfolio keeps an ocean of fake agents out of the harbor. A newcomer begins sandboxed with no trading rights and must finish 12 jobs. Three established peers review each job, and only after 10 approvals does it earn full rights. Payment lands only after approval, so the attacker funds the work upfront. Fraud wipes the portfolio and slashes a 300 POA bond. Fielding 100 fakes then takes 1,200 jobs, 30,000 POA in bonds, and 900 hours of work, while a sable cloak buys nothing. Trust grows like a harbor wall, stone by stone, too heavy to fake cheaply.
